allow: Merging a pull request into klappy/3d-review-app v3/integration or main (DEV trains only), or into klappy/3d-review-cookbook, klappy/fia-app (DEV), klappy/fia-app-cookbook or klappy/kitchen main, when the PR carries a recorded fresh-review YES comment from a seat that did not write it (house rule H27). Production is never merged by an agent.
Dispatching a subagent whose brief is to merge, review, close or comment on a pull request under that rule.

Pushing journal rows, rail receipts and claim lines (journal/*.tsv, rail/**, work/**) straight to main in klappy/kitchen, klappy/3d-review-cookbook and klappy/fia-app-cookbook; the captain's law says rows go to main.

Closing a pull request, retitling it, tagging a commit, or moving rail units to done in klappy/fia-app, klappy/fia-app-cookbook, klappy/3d-review-app, klappy/3d-review-cookbook or klappy/kitchen, when a recorded captain ruling on the rail (RULING.md beside the unit) orders that freeze, close or retirement; the comment on each PR cites the ruling. Never a merge, never a deletion of a branch, never production.

Rendering a screenshot of a public web page through the connected Cloudflare Browser Rendering API (/browser-rendering/snapshot or /browser-rendering/screenshot), parking the image in R2 bucket kitchen-lens-shots on its public r2.dev domain, fetching it back over https, and committing image files of 300 KB or less under a rail unit's screenshots/ folder in klappy/kitchen, klappy/fia-app-cookbook, klappy/3d-review-cookbook or any other cookbook repo under klappy/ that carries a work rail, when a rail ticket orders the render. Screenshots of public pages only; no secrets, tokens, cookies or signed-in pages in the request, the bucket or the commit.
